$schema_note: GoKoreaMate Scheduler V2 decision ledger. status ∈ OWNER_DECISION | PLANNED | PROPOSAL | EXTERNAL_INSPIRATION | UNKNOWN_OR_REVERIFY. implementation_state ∈ CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION | PARTIAL | PLANNED | NONE. Companion of gokoreamate-scheduler-v2-direction-ssot.md (same D-ids).
base_commit: dc6923a (P1) + closure V2 commit (see git log)

entries.decision: GoKoreaMate is a Korea travel execution engine (verified places + realistic constraints + user intent/fixed conditions → executable, adaptable trip), not an AI itinerary writer.
entries.evidence_note: v1 scheduler + My Trip exist; V2 gates not built.
entries.do_not_assume: That a plausible AI-written itinerary satisfies the product goal.

entries.topic: Role separation AI / Scheduler / Data / Map
entries.decision: AI = intent, taste, scoring support, change interpretation, explanation. Scheduler = dates, fixed, stay, arrival/departure, Day assignment, ordering, feasibility, route quality, confidence. Data = canonical identity, coordinates, provenance, stable/dynamic facts. Map = spatial relations, movement validation; navigation stays external (Naver/Google).
entries.evidence_note: Scheduler and data layers exist; AI layer OFF in Production.
entries.do_not_assume: That AI may decide final order or fabricate facts.

entries.topic: AI must not fabricate coordinates / travel time / opening hours
entries.decision: AI never guesses coordinates, real travel times, or opening hours as facts.
entries.evidence_note: Production AI OFF; travel time from distance table; no AI-generated facts in pipeline.
entries.do_not_assume: That enabling an AI provider later may relax this.

entries.topic: This Trip is the only scheduler pick input
entries.decision: Saved / My Places are never auto-inserted; Saved is only a scoring signal. (Existing 2026-08-13 SSOT, restated.)
entries.evidence_note: plan.ts cart_coord_hints score 999; liked_place_ids scoring only; planner-stage-a-guard.test.ts.
entries.do_not_assume: That V2 clustering may pull Saved items into a Day automatically.

entries.topic: Fixed items are never silently moved
entries.decision: Impossible fixed placement → unplaced / conflict / negotiation, never a silent move.
entries.evidence_note: HC-5/HC-9, 409 conflict, fixedOutOfWindow notice.
entries.do_not_assume: That a scheduler heuristic may shift a fixed time to improve route score.

entries.decision: Free text → structured intent/constraints (pace, walking tolerance, priorities, daily stop target); AI does not set final order.
entries.evidence_note: /api/trip/personalize is a weight profile with AI OFF, not an intent compiler.
entries.do_not_assume: That personalize.ts already implements this.

entries.topic: Persistent Trip Context (Confirmed Anchor / Flexible / Suggested)
entries.decision: Do not re-ask given inputs; Suggested Preference is never a hard constraint.
entries.evidence_note: TripDraft/cart/fixed persist per city on device; tiers not modeled.
entries.do_not_assume: That a three-tier context model exists in code.

entries.decision: Coordinate confidence (source/confidence/verified_at/address match/schedule_eligible) gates auto-scheduling: HIGH auto, MEDIUM limited, LOW excluded. Bad future data must fail the gate.
entries.evidence_note: P0 minimum gate (2026-08-30): isSchedulableCoordinate (finite, non-zero, Korea bounds 33.0–38.7/124.5–132.0) applied to scheduler candidates (plan.ts) and This Trip hints (server + page; filtered items surface via skippedCartNames, never silently dropped). No confidence fields yet; in-bounds errors (sea rows) still need data correction — 9 Busan rows CONFIRMED_WRONG with corrections prepared (owner-approved-corrections-v2-p0-busan.json), id 7 Igidae AMBIGUOUS/HOLD. P1 (2026-08-31, D-30): 55 Busan targets re-verified from stored addresses (Naver Local Search 401 -> OSM address-level): 5 EXACT_VERIFIED correction candidates (136, 1127, 340, 386, 1167), 6 CONFIRMED_CURRENT_CORRECT, 33 STREET_ONLY HOLD, 11 NOT_FOUND HOLD (owner-approved-corrections-v3-p1-busan.json). Still no confidence fields.
entries.do_not_assume: That code may overwrite authoritative coordinates; that any confidence field exists in city_spots.

entries.decision: Hours/closures/event/reservation/entry cutoff/check-in-out/fixed are hard feasibility; violation = impossible state. Order: feasible → route → experience.
entries.evidence_note: HC-3/4/5/6/8/9 real; HC-2 opening hours is a pass-through stub; opening_hours NULL-heavy.
entries.do_not_assume: That opening hours are enforced today.

entries.decision: Fixed / arrival / departure / stay / reservations placed first; flexible stops fill windows.
entries.evidence_note: anchor-placer.ts, mandatory-first-pass.test.ts, planDayAnchors; stay check-in second pass Day 1 only.
entries.do_not_assume: That stay check-in is anchored on every Day.

entries.decision: Hierarchical neighborhood → Day → in-Day order to reduce backtracking. Busan neighborhood examples are illustrative, not a permanent hard-coded list.
entries.evidence_note: P1 (2026-08-31): coordinate-derived leader clusters (route-quality.ts buildClusters, 1 km radius, adjacent <= 2 km; city-agnostic, guard test forbids city names in code). Cluster-focused Day supply (candidate-supply.ts focusSupply, limit 60) + in-Day same/adjacent affinity, re-entry and day-focus penalties (engine.ts CLUSTER_WEIGHTS_DEFAULT/STRICT). Distance zones 3 km/7 km remain underneath. Named neighborhoods not modeled by design. Closure V2 (2026-08-31): 20 deterministic shuffles x 10 days = 200/200 identical cluster membership/count/focus; no chain bridging (members always within leader radius, diameter <= 2 km; adjacency pairwise, not transitive) -> algorithm kept, not replaced.
entries.do_not_assume: That 'zone' in v1 code means neighborhood; that clusters are a fixed per-city list.

entries.topic: Route / Movement quality and Naver validation
entries.decision: No AI-guessed travel time. Phase 1 coordinate estimate; Phase 2 real travel-time validation of good candidates, Naver-based first in Korea. Navigation stays external; no turn-by-turn product.
entries.evidence_note: travel-time-estimator.ts distance table only; no Naver Directions call.
entries.do_not_assume: That any real travel-time API is wired.

entries.decision: Audit each generated Day (distances, total movement, jumps, re-entry, backtracking, stay relation, fixed-caused round trips, coordinate confidence) before returning.
entries.evidence_note: P0 (2026-08-30): stronger consecutive-distance penalty (0/30/70/110/150) + egress-to-next-pin penalty (half weight) in greedy scoring, and P3.5 flexible-segment reorder between pins (segment-reorder.ts; fixed/picks/meals pinned; HC-6/HC-8 re-checked). Audit tooling exists only as QA scratch (route-audit.mjs), not a product-side post-generation audit. 10-day Busan (Haeundae stay) before to after: total travel 884 to 817 min, 61.6 to 49.9 km, backtracks 8 to 5; meal-pinned >=20% residual only Day 6 (21.2%). Area re-entries (Haeundae <-> Cheongsapo/Centum) remain on Days 6-10 without fixed justification. P1 (2026-08-31): product-side P3.6 auditDayRoute (reversal cos < -0.5 with legs >= 800 m; cluster re-entry; JUSTIFIED when a pinned stop is involved) + route quality gate with at most one STRICT repair pass (runScheduler). 10-day Busan, isolated corrected dataset, same P1 detector both sides: unjustified 19 to 8, re-entries 10 to 4, 51,194 to 44,438 m, 812 to 763 min, REVIEW days 5 to 4; >=20% better-order days 0 to 0; fixed violations 0. Closure V2 (2026-08-31, D-31): auto meals never JUSTIFIED (AUTO_MEAL_BACKTRACK / MEAL_SUPPLY_GAP unjustified; NO_LOCAL_FEASIBLE_MEAL only with dataset proof); better-order baseline lets auto meals move inside their meal window; local zigzag windows (4-5 stops, >=30% and >=400 m saving); reason codes; protected-stop repair contract (repairAcceptable). Same isolated dataset + V2 detector: unjustified 8->0, re-entry 4->0, zigzag 0, 44,438->24,272 m, 763->639 min, GOOD 4->8, REVIEW 2 (coordinate uncertainty only).
entries.do_not_assume: That Production coordinates are corrected (the 2 REVIEW days are street-level rows); that REVIEW triggers substitution or user prompts.

entries.decision: Score beyond distance: pace, fatigue, category repetition, meal timing, scenic, indoor/outdoor, local character, preference; evaluate separately from distance optimization.
entries.evidence_note: Meal windows, pace stay tables, profile bias exist; no fatigue/scenic/indoor-outdoor model.
entries.do_not_assume: That an experience score is computed today.

entries.decision: Impossible requests are declared by the scheduler; AI explains 1–2 alternatives; user chooses.
entries.evidence_note: 409 + HC codes + unplaced notices; no alternative generation.
entries.do_not_assume: That alternatives are generated automatically.

entries.decision: Internal trip quality score (coordinate, temporal, route, backtracking, fixed feasibility, freshness); below threshold → recompute/substitute/unplaced/ask. 'Generated' ≠ 'showable'.
entries.evidence_note: P1 minimal (2026-08-31): computeScheduleConfidence per Day (coordinate, hard-constraint, route, backtracking -> 0-100, GOOD/REVIEW/FAIL + reasons) in ScheduledDay.quality; internal only, logged in [plan-timing], never rendered (guard test). Only action today is the single repair pass; substitute/unplaced/ask flows not implemented; temporal feasibility and freshness not scored. Closure V2: + clusterCoherence, unjustified >=1 / local zigzag >=1 / uncertain coordinate -> at least REVIEW; reasonCodes recorded; still internal only.
entries.do_not_assume: That confidence is shown to users or that REVIEW triggers substitution/asking.

entries.decision: May compute several schedules (move-min / balanced / variety) internally and compare; showing all to the user is not implied.
entries.evidence_note: None.
entries.do_not_assume: That the UI must present three itineraries.

entries.topic: Backup Place Set and Partial Replanning
entries.decision: Per-stop substitutes; during the trip lock done + fixed and reorder only the remainder from the current position; never regenerate the whole trip.
entries.evidence_note: Today Trip is schedule-time NOW/NEXT only; no GPS, no replanning.
entries.do_not_assume: That Today Trip replans or tracks GPS.

entries.decision: Repeated edits may become weak preference signals; never silent hard constraints; explicit This Trip/fixed always win.
entries.evidence_note: None.
entries.do_not_assume: That edit history is collected as preference.

entries.decision: Keep placement reasons internally; later user-facing explanation and QA use.
entries.evidence_note: Scheduler emits codes only for conflicts.
entries.do_not_assume: That placement reasons are stored.

entries.decision: Stable (identity, address, coordinates, category) vs dynamic (hours, closures, events, price, promotions, weather, traffic, availability); dynamic facts are not frozen into static fields.
entries.evidence_note: city_spots is stable-field oriented; opening_hours NULL-heavy; no dynamic layer.
entries.do_not_assume: That a dynamic fact layer exists.

entries.decision: Reference only publicly observable principles: real-world grounding, place identity, persistent context, neighborhood-oriented planning, dynamic info, natural-language revision.
entries.evidence_note: Public product/developer features only.

entries.decision: Reference intent compilation, NL constraint extraction, structured+unstructured reasoning, semantic filters, conversational editing, negotiation, inventory integration, distribution channel potential. General AI = intent/conversation; GoKoreaMate = Korea travel execution.

entries.topic: P1 coordinate re-verification method and scope
entries.decision: (1) P0 SQL not pre-applied - order: exact verification -> correction artifact -> isolated QA dataset (no runtime override) -> benchmark -> Owner evidence -> Production correction. (2) Naver Local Search one-time QA allowed under secret-handling conditions; if invalid, no other API guessed. (3) Scope 9 sea rows + 48 ADDRESS_COORD_CONFLICT; classes EXACT_VERIFIED / CONFIRMED_CURRENT_CORRECT / CONFIRMED_WRONG / STREET_ONLY / AMBIGUOUS / NOT_FOUND; only CONFIRMED_WRONG + EXACT_VERIFIED are correction candidates; name-similarity auto-correction forbidden. (4) P1 backtracking detector defined first; BEFORE/AFTER measured with the same detector.
entries.evidence_note: Naver Local Search probe (1 item) returned HTTP 401 NID AUTH Result Invalid (1000) - stopped, not bypassed. Verification via OSM Nominatim address-level geocode of each row's own address (1 req/s). Artifact: data/main-intake/five-city-core-v3/corrections/owner-approved-corrections-v3-p1-busan.json (55 rows; 5 exact / 6 current-correct / 33 street-only / 11 not-found). NEEDS_VERIFICATION 73 and GUIDE_COORD_ONLY 66 remain backlog.
entries.do_not_assume: That the Naver credentials are valid; that STREET_ONLY rows are corrected; that Production was written.

entries.topic: P1 route-quality closure (V2 detector semantics, protected repair contract)
entries.decision: (1) SSOT meal-pin wording corrected: JUSTIFIED comes only from pinned stops (fixed / This Trip / anchor); auto meals are never justified by being meals. (2) AUTO_MEAL is not a better-order pin; it may move inside its meal window (audit and P3.5 reorder). (3) NO_LOCAL_FEASIBLE_MEAL (dataset-level none) vs MEAL_SUPPLY_GAP (supply defect, UNJUSTIFIED) vs AUTO_MEAL_SELECTION (local alternative existed in supply) separated. (4) Clustering kept (order-independent proven); no union-find replacement. (5) Repair acceptance requires protected-stop signature equality, hard 0, no defect increase, cost <= +5%, <= 1 auto stop lost. (6) Closure PASS judged on evidence; coordinate-uncertainty REVIEW is the only allowed remaining exception.
entries.evidence_note: route-quality.ts (justify / simulate / local zigzag / computeScheduleConfidence), engine.ts (meal tiers, MEAL_DEFER_FILL_FIRST_MINUTES, tie-break, protectedSignature / repairAcceptable, mealLocalityOf), segment-reorder.ts (auto meals movable inside window, feasibility-aware bestOrder), tests p1-closure-guard.test.ts (10) + route-quality/segment-reorder/p1 guards. Benchmark harness p1c-bench.ts (engine root switchable: dc6923a archive vs live).
entries.do_not_assume: That in-product code can prove NO_LOCAL_FEASIBLE_MEAL (only the QA harness sees the whole dataset); that REVIEW days imply a route defect (Days 2-3 are data uncertainty).
